summary: First-principles design review, iteration 13 (full record in review_loop/scrutiny_13.md). The headline claim, confirmatory family, matching design, and SS0.1 framing were re-examined and stand. This pass executed iteration 12's named worklist — relevance.py internals, make_figures on partial artifacts, the echo-scoring contract, and the end-to-end doc chain — plus a fourth spot-check of the estimator stack, and found one substantive defect: (T1, major, fixed) the R3.3 quantization-grid exclusion was DOCUMENTED but NOT IMPLEMENTED. GOLD_STANDARD R3.3 and RESULTS.md threat 9 both promised that instances whose realized candidate count N deviates from the modal N (whose discrete entropies therefore sit on a different partition-quantization grid — the ceiling is ln N, so under-delivered instances read as deflated entropy) are excluded from pooled tau/strata analyses; in reality tau_sweep.py pooled them into branch_rate/gated_pass_rate while only flagging non_modal_n_instances, and compute_metrics.py's R5.2 strata, median threshold, and R5.4 low-entropy labels had no realized-N input at all — a mixed-grid median would have systematically pushed under-delivered instances into the 'low entropy' bucket and inflated the off-mode (mode-collapse signature) candidate list with proposer-under-delivery artifacts. Fixed at both consumers: tau_sweep pools only modal-N instances (n_pooled_instances, excluded_from_pooled_rows; full per_instance reporting retained); compute_metrics gains load_realized_n (same last-block member-line parse tau_sweep uses), excludes off-grid instances from strata + threshold (strata_modal_n, strata_grid_excluded, strata_grid_note), and off-mode records for off-grid instances carry low_entropy=null with the reason; the SDLG arm (no partition logged) explicitly states no guard is possible rather than implying it ran. The fix is conservative for the SS0.1 narrative and touches no confirmatory number (H1/H2 use patch signatures and eval outcomes only). Four smaller honesty defects also fixed: make_figures rendered missing metric cells as silent 0-height bars and crashed on ci95=null (now annotated 'n/a' + warning); relevance.py's docstring sold the DeBERTa-NLI path while the live config disables it (relevance_use_nli=false — 'entailment != topical relevance') and carried dead has_strategy code (docstring rewritten with backend dispatch + symmetric-across-arms failure semantics, dead code removed, config comment corrected); the echo-scoring graceful-degradation contract (vLLM rejecting max_tokens=0/echo=True -> out-of-top-k substitutes score I_ij=0.0) lived only in code docstrings, now disclosed in RESULTS SS2.4 AND converted to a pre-launch check — smoke_test.py probes both raw completions request shapes the SDLG importance scorer depends on; smoke_test.py also probed the wrong port (8000, owned by the pdf-reader relay; live config is 8001). Clean seams: estimator stack fourth spot-check (Chen product form, rarefaction identity, exact sign-flip with tie floor 2^(1+z-n), seeded bootstrap, pairwise-distance caveats), compare()'s k* discipline and artifact-encoded H1->H2 gate, budget_audit both-layout accounting, campaign dry-run (re-verified post-edit; nothing in the driver parses the extended JSON schemas), doc chain, collect_results.py confirmed legacy. 136 tests pass (132 -> 136), py_compile clean, work committed (8ba530d). Generalizing lesson: a disclosed limitation is not yet a guarded one — three of five findings were risks the docs described correctly but no artifact enforced. Because this iteration found and fixed a real spec/artifact mismatch, gold_standard_met is FALSE per the charter; one more fresh pass should sweep the last corners (phases.py transition details, nli_server device handling, final CLI-vs-docs check) before the loop goes quiet.

issues_found.title: R3.3 quantization-grid exclusion was documented but not implemented: tau_sweep pooled non-modal-N instances into its sweep rows (flag-only) and compute_metrics' R5.2 strata, median threshold, and R5.4 low-entropy labels had no realized-N awareness — RESULTS threat 9's 'excluded from tau/strata pooling' claim was false of the artifacts, and grid mixing would have deflated under-delivered instances' entropies into the low stratum, inflating the off-mode candidate list
issues_found.rationale: Implemented at both consumers with a shared definition of realized N (same last-block member-line parse); exclusion lists and notes in the artifacts; SDLG arm's no-partition limitation stated explicitly; conservative direction for the SS0.1 narrative; confirmatory endpoints untouched. Tests pin the discriminating behavior (a tau row that would read 2/3 under pooling reads 1.0 on the modal grid).

issues_found.title: make_figures.py rendered missing metric cells as silent 0-height bars (indistinguishable from a true zero in a paper figure) and crashed on ci95=null in partial/legacy artifacts
issues_found.rationale: Missing/None cells now draw nothing, annotate 'n/a', and print a warning; tolerant ci95 handling; applied to both the per-arm charts and the H1 comparison figure. Fail-loud was rejected because the script legitimately regenerates figures from partial mid-campaign artifacts.

issues_found.title: relevance.py module docstring described the DeBERTa-NLI entailment path as THE method while the live config disables it (relevance_use_nli=false), the config comment mislabeled the threshold as 'entailment per Kuhn et al.', and has_strategy was dead code
issues_found.rationale: Docstring rewritten to state the backend dispatch, the live default (LLM 0-10 scorer), why NLI was rejected (entailment != topical relevance), and the failure semantics (symmetric across arms — not a treatment/control confound); dead method removed; config comment corrected.

issues_found.title: The echo-scoring graceful-degradation contract (vLLM rejecting max_tokens=0/echo=True silently zeroes I_ij for out-of-top-k substitutes) was disclosed only in code docstrings, not in RESULTS SS2.4, and was verifiable only at run time
issues_found.rationale: Disclosed in RESULTS SS2.4 deviation 1, and smoke_test.py now probes both raw /v1/completions request shapes (top-k logprobs; echo prompt-logprobs) with the exact JSON sdlg.py sends — a disclosed risk became a checked pre-launch precondition.

issues_found.title: smoke_test.py probed port 8000 (owned by the pdf-reader relay on this machine) instead of the live 8001 pinned by configs/branching.yaml and start_vllm.sh — a pre-launch test that fails against a healthy server invites the wrong fix
issues_found.rationale: Corrected to 8001 with the machine fact in a comment; same root cause family as iteration 12's T1 (the port-8000 default surviving from early development).
